card.name: Table numbers before table titles
card.fires_on: The table number right after the word Table when a new table caption begins, often before a title like Mean Change or Changes in. Also seen once inside the drug name finasteride before a percentage.

modes.label: Table caption number
modes.description: The digit after Table that starts a caption line, where a title about changes or averages follows.

modes.label: Inside finasteride
modes.description: The last piece of the drug name finasteride before a percentage comparison with placebo.

card.writes: It promotes the word mean and its variants, which fits captions like Mean Change in.
card.plain: It fires on the number in a table heading, getting ready for a title such as Mean Change in.
